title: Page 9
content_zh:
好熟悉的情景，只是，以往都是她抓住他的手在「保护」他，现在换成是他在保护别的女人……
心口一紧，酸涩滋味涌上心头。
那个女子看起来像是名媛千金，她的跑车车头有点凹陷，如果不是车祸就是自己撞到路边，总之，他就是去帮她处理。她一通电话来，他马上就赶到，显然他们的交情……还不错。
而且面对那女子，一整天板着脸的他居然能开怀笑着，可见那女子的魅力有多大。
原本她还庆幸他的二嫂不是名媛千金，那他们的恋情就能开花，进而修成正果，一辈子相守，今天她很想问他，想从他口中确定他父毋不会因为「门不当、户不对」拒绝她，但现在不必了。
他和那位名媛千金看起来颇登对，香车、美人是他生活圈的一部份，以前是，现在是，未来也都是。
这也许就是她保贝儿的宿命，私心认定的长久爱情，最终都会栽在「门当户对」这一关。
会的，她会记得，以后谈恋爱的对象，她会避开有钱人家的小开，尽量找一个她们家能匹配的对象。
想到方才他呵护那位名媛千金的情景，心口一揪，泪水不自觉地流了下来。
保贝儿抹去滑落脸颊的眼泪，吸了吸鼻子。有什么好哭的？她是他的特助，她「保护」他是应该的，只是从今以后他保护的对象并不是她，如此而已。
面向窗外，热泪止不住的流……
滴滴清泪滚落怀中装着寿司的小袋上，似乎也在为它们未受眷顾而啜泣着。
========================
第10章(2)
隔天保贝儿请假未上班，不是她伤心之余不愿面对掌尚勇，而是天未亮母亲就打电话告诉她哥哥的继母溜到医院，假装清洁人员趁机想拿刀杀哥哥，还好当时沈嘉雄也在，及时阻止了她，但行凶的继母却逃走了。
保贝儿赶到医院，警察也到场，众人在讨论哥哥继母行凶的动机，哥哥似乎有知觉，手一直动，医生正要查看哥哥的状况，突然哥哥奇迹地醒了！
高兴之余，却知道一个令他们震慑的消息。
刚醒来的保俊尽管元气虚弱，说话速度极缓慢，他仍坚持一个字、一个字将事发经过告诉他们，要贝儿和母亲提高警觉。
「是那个女人撞你的，她到底有没有良心！」林湘云又惊又气。
原来哥哥的继母除了婚前所生的女儿并不是父亲的亲骨肉之外，婚后又有外遇，她和小她五岁的外遇对象，计划卷走父亲的财产，打算一走逃到国外，谁知钱一到手，她就被外遇对象给一脚踢开，那人带走所有财产逃到国外，她却一毛钱都没拿到，为了生活只好下海，而她女儿看不起她，人也不知跑哪里去了。

一年前她搭上一位乡下的大财主，欢喜当「二奶」之余，突然想到万一哥哥不放过她，那她下半辈子就得在牢里度过，所以她偷偷找人想和哥哥「谈和解」，但哥哥不肯，所以出事的那天早上就是她开车撞哥哥，她以为哥哥死了，才开车离去，没想到哥哥没死，她或许担心哥哥会醒来，才狠心的想来杀死哥哥。
母亲气腾腾地哭诉那女人害自己家庭破裂，现在竟然又想杀她儿子。
一整个上午医院的康复中心病房里闹烘烘的，警察、医生、护士、母亲不断地有人在说话，她觉得头昏脑胀，突然想吐……
「贝儿，我看你暂时别去上斑，免得那女人抓狂，也想伤害你……」
母亲叮咛的话说了第十遍，胃里一阵翻腾，保贝儿突然冲进浴室，不断地干呕。
===========================
她怀孕了！这一点都不令她意外，因为他们根本没避孕，从一开始她就打算和他厮守终生，只不过这一切在一夕之间悄悄变了调。
也许他长久和名媛千金相处，突然遇到她这个「灰姑娘」觉得挺新鲜有趣，然而相处久了，或许又觉得名媛千金才是最适合他。
她实在不愿把他想成这种糟糕透顶的烂人，她所认识的掌尚勇也不可能是这种人，但昨天她亲眼所见，他面对那位千金小姐时，一张嘴可是乐得咧到耳后去了。
「贝儿。你跑去哪里了？妈找你好久，我还以为你跑出去，吓死我了。」林湘云看见女儿在医院走廊发呆，赶紧将她拉往康复中心的方向。
「我只是在医院里走一走。」她去妇产科做检查没让母亲知道，因为母亲要担心的事情太多了，她暂时不想增添母亲的烦恼。
「你可千万别出去，万一那女人发了疯也想开车撞你……」林湘云低声喃喃念着，「菩萨保佑、菩萨保佑……」
哥哥的病房前依旧挤了一群医生，甚至还有媒体记者闻风而来，站在一堆人后面她连哥哥的面都看不到，索性坐在一旁发呆。
她想着怀孕的事，想着肚里有个她和尚勇共有的小生命，想着该不该告诉他，想着母亲的叮咛，想着日前他俩差点被车撞……
被车撞？思及此，她心头陡地一惊，那该不会是……当时她就觉得那辆车仿佛是蓄意要撞他们，现在获悉哥哥继母开车冲撞哥哥，那该不会也是她……
保贝儿倏地站起身，如果那回真的是哥哥继母开车要冲撞她，那她一定知道她现在是尚勇的特助，她若想掌握她的行踪，一定会锁定尚勇，万一她真的发了疯，很可能不管尚勇身边的女人是不是她，铁定直接开车冲撞过去。
这么一来，尚勇肯定会有危险！
不行，她要通知他。
她拿出手机，边打电话边往外走，拨了好几通他的私人手机都没回应，总裁办公室的电话也没人接，打到掌家，管家说他没回去，她想，他或许回公寓去了。
心中忐忑不安，总感觉好像有什么事要发生。

不行！若没找到他，亲口告诉他要提防这事，她不能安心。
毋亲的叮咛言犹在耳，可她不能坐视不管，如果那女人真的疯了，尚勇一定会成为代罪羔羊。
管不了那么多了，她一定要去找尚勇！
保贝儿快步走出医院，站在路边正要拦计程车。一辆车突然朝她直冲过来，她吓呆了，吃惊地瞪大眼，她看到驾驶人就是哥哥的继母。
「啊——」除了尖叫，她完全无法做出任何反应，双脚像生了根似的动也动不了，只能眼睁睁看着车子撞向她——
=======================================================
一天。才一天没看她，他的脑子里满满都是她的身影。
从早上她打电话请假那一刻，他就开始思念她。今天他特地空着肚子上班，想她或许又会为他准备早餐，不想再看到昨日她失望的表情，他已打算今天若她又带亲手做的餐点，他一定把它们全部吃光光，绝对不会再吃飞醋而不理她，没想到，她打电话来说医院有事要请假。
一整个早上他都在懊悔昨日为何没一口气把她做的爱心早餐吃得精光，害她失望，他其实也不好受，只是那莫名的飞醋一直盘踞心口，酸得他难受至极。
下班前，他打了好几通电话想约她吃晚餐，手机一直关机中，家里电话也没人接，他不得不猜想，该不会昨日他不理她，今日她就闹脾气？手机一丢，他素性直奔她家，想直接找她向她道歉。
content_en:
It's such a familiar scene, but in the past, she held his hand to "protect" him, but now it's him who is protecting other women...
My heart tightened, a sour taste welling up in my heart.
The woman looked like the daughter of a socialite. The front of her sports car was a little dented. If it wasn't a car accident, she would have hit the roadside by herself. In short, he went to help her deal with it. As soon as she called, he rushed over immediately. It was obvious that their friendship was... not bad.
Moreover, facing that woman, he could actually smile heartily despite having a straight face all day long, which showed how charming that woman was.
Originally, she was glad that his second sister-in-law was not a rich lady, so that their love could bloom and become a positive relationship, and they would stay together for the rest of their lives. Today, she really wanted to ask him, and wanted to make sure from his mouth that his father would not reject her because of "the wrong family, the wrong household", but there is no need for it now.
He and the famous lady seemed to be a perfect match. The car and the beautiful woman were part of his life circle, they were before, they were now, and they would be in the future.
This may be her fate in protecting Bei Er. The long-term love that she believes in selfishly will eventually fall into the trap of being a "well-matched match."
Yes, she will remember that when she falls in love with someone in the future, she will avoid Xiaokai from a wealthy family and try her best to find a partner that her family can match.
Thinking of the scene where he protected the daughter of a famous lady just now, his heart clenched and tears flowed down unconsciously.
Bao Beier wiped away the tears falling down her cheeks and sniffed. What's there to cry about? She is his special assistant, and she should "protect" him, but from now on, the person he is protecting is not her, that's all.
Facing the window, tears could not stop flowing...
Drops of clear tears rolled down the small bag of sushi in his arms, seeming to be sobbing because they were not cared for.
========================
Chapter 10(2)
The next day, Bao Beier asked for leave and did not go to work. It was not that she was sad and did not want to face Zhang Shangyong, but her mother called her before dawn and told her brother's stepmother to sneak into the hospital, pretending to be a cleaning staff and took the opportunity to kill her brother with a knife. Fortunately, Shen Jiaxiong was there at the time and stopped her in time, but the stepmother who committed the crime escaped.
Bao Beier rushed to the hospital and the police also arrived. Everyone was discussing the motive of the brother's stepmother's murder. The brother seemed to be conscious and kept moving his hands. The doctor was about to check his condition when suddenly he miraculously woke up!
Although they were happy, they learned a piece of news that shocked them.
Although Baojun, who had just woken up, was weak and spoke very slowly, he still insisted on telling them what happened word by word, asking Belle and her mother to be more vigilant.
"That woman hit you. Does she have any conscience?" Lin Xiangyun was shocked and angry.
It turned out that her brother's stepmother had an affair after marriage, in addition to the daughter born before marriage, who was not her father's flesh and blood. She and her affair partner, who was five years younger than her, planned to take away her father's property and flee abroad. Unexpectedly, as soon as she got the money, she was kicked away by her affair partner.
A year ago, she hooked up with a rich man in the countryside, and while she was enjoying being the "second wife", she suddenly thought that if her brother didn't let her go, she would have to spend the rest of her life in prison, so she secretly found someone to "negotiate reconciliation" with her brother, but his brother refused, so she was the one who hit her brother with her car the morning of the accident.
The mother cried angrily that the woman had caused her family to break up, and now she wanted to kill her son.
The hospital's rehabilitation center ward was noisy all morning. The police, doctors, nurses, and mother were constantly talking. She felt dizzy and suddenly wanted to vomit...
"Belle,I think you shouldn’t do the spotting for now, lest the woman goes crazy and wants to hurt you..."
After her mother's instructions for the tenth time, her stomach churned, and Baby suddenly rushed into the bathroom, retching continuously.
===========================
She's pregnant! This didn't surprise her at all, because they didn't use contraception at all. From the beginning, she planned to stay with him for life, but everything quietly changed overnight.
Maybe he has been with the daughter of a famous lady for a long time, and suddenly meeting her as a "Cinderella" felt very fresh and interesting. However, after getting along for a long time, he may feel that the daughter of a famous lady is the most suitable for him.
She really didn't want to think of him as such a terrible person, and the Zhang Shangyong she knew couldn't be such a person, but she saw with her own eyes yesterday that when he faced the rich lady, he grinned happily behind his ears.
"Belle, where did you run away? Mom has been looking for you for a long time. I thought you ran away. It scared me to death." Lin Xiangyun saw his daughter in a daze in the corridor of the hospital and quickly pulled her towards the rehabilitation center.
"I was just taking a walk in the hospital." She went to the obstetrics and gynecology department for a check-up without letting her mother know because her mother had too many things to worry about and she didn't want to add to her mother's worries for the time being.
"You must not go out, if that woman goes crazy and wants to hit you with her car..." Lin Xiangyun murmured in a low voice, "Bodhisattva bless, Bodhisattva bless..."
A group of doctors were still crowded in front of her brother's ward, and even media reporters came after hearing the news. Standing behind a group of people, she couldn't even see her brother's face, so she simply sat aside in a daze.
She was thinking about her pregnancy, thinking about the little life she and Shang Yong shared in her belly, thinking about whether she should tell him, thinking about her mother's warning, thinking about the two of them almost being hit by a car a few days ago...
Hit by a car? Thinking of this, she was suddenly shocked. Could it be... At that time, she felt that the car seemed to hit them deliberately. Now that she learned that her brother's stepmother drove into her brother, could it be her...
Bao Beier stood up quickly. If it was really her brother and stepmother who wanted to drive into her that time, then she must know that she is now Shang Yong's special assistant. If she wants to know her whereabouts, she will definitely target Shang Yong. If she really goes crazy, she will probably drive directly over Shang Yong regardless of whether the woman next to him is her.
In this case, Shang Yong will definitely be in danger!
No, she wanted to inform him.
She took out her mobile phone and walked out while making a call. She called his personal mobile phone several times but there was no response. No one answered the phone in the president's office. When she called the housekeeper, the housekeeper said that he had not gone back. She thought that maybe he had gone back to the apartment.
I felt uneasy and uneasy, always feeling like something was about to happen.
no! If she didn't find him and told him personally to be careful about this, she wouldn't be able to rest at ease.
Wuqin's warnings were still ringing in her ears, but she couldn't sit idly by. If that woman was really crazy, Shang Yong would definitely become the scapegoat.
She couldn't care less, she had to go find Shang Yong!
Bao Beier quickly walked out of the hospital and stood on the roadside, about to stop a taxi. A car suddenly rushed towards her. She was stunned and her eyes widened in surprise. She saw that the driver was her brother's stepmother.
"Ah——" She couldn't react at all except screaming. Her feet seemed to have taken root and she couldn't move. She could only watch the car crash into her——
=======================================================
One day. It had only been a day since he had seen her, and his mind was filled with her image.
From the moment she called to ask for leave in the morning, he began to miss her. Today he went to work on an empty stomach, thinking that she might prepare breakfast for him again. He didn't want to see her disappointed expression yesterday again. He had already planned that if she brought home-made meals again today, he would definitely bring it.We ate them all and would never ignore her out of jealousy again. Unexpectedly, she called to say that she had something to do at the hospital and asked for leave.
All morning long, he was regretting why he didn't eat all the love breakfast she made in one breath yesterday, which disappointed her. He actually felt uncomfortable, but the inexplicable jealousy kept occupying his heart, making him extremely uncomfortable.
Before getting off work, he made several phone calls to ask her to have dinner. His phone was always turned off, and no one answered the phone at home. He had to wonder, could it be that he ignored her yesterday and she lost her temper today? As soon as he lost his phone, he went straight to her house, wanting to find her directly and apologize to her.
